Welcome aboard, pilot!

Start — your plane
Goal — the runway hold line
Closed taxiway — no entry
Runway — never drive along it
Crossing — stop, look, cross straight over

How to play

  1. Find the blue plane. That is you, parked at a hangar or on the apron.
  2. Taxi to the yellow GO circle at the edge of the runway. Use a pencil or a felt-tip pen and stay inside the white taxiways — Level 3 is best with a sharp pencil.
  3. Orange cones mean "taxiway closed" — you cannot pass. Turn around and find another way.
  4. The black runway is for take-off. Never drive along it — cross only where a white taxiway goes straight over it, and stop at the yellow lines first!
  5. Every maze has exactly one open route. Answer keys are at the back.

Three levels

Little Pilot is a small corner of the airport. Co-Pilot opens more taxiways. Captain is the big one.

Colouring pages

Colour your airport — the runway, the taxiways and the buildings — and find the hidden planes. Then sign your pilot certificate!

Grown-ups

These are real airport layouts drawn from open map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License at openstreetmap.org/copyright; airport reference points from OurAirports (public domain). The closed taxiways are invented for the game. For play only — never for navigation, flight planning or training.

Printing: pages are US Letter; the A4 file in your download fits A4 paper. Print at 100 % (no "fit to page" needed). Personal use only — please do not resell or share the files.
